a patient of this surgery for over 15 years i want to share my experiences at Gaumount House Surgery. Unfortunately, I have repeatedly encountered issues that have left me extremely disappointed with the level of service provided.

The reception staff have often come across as rude and unprofessional, showing very little customer-service awareness or compassion toward patients. On several occasions, I felt spoken to in an abrupt and unhelpful manner, which only added to the stress of trying to get medical support.

I have also experienced long waiting that caused real inconvenience and left me feeling that patients’ time is not valued.

Another ongoing issue is the difficulty reaching the practice by phone.There have been many times when calls go unanswered for long periods, even during working hours. This is especially frustrating when you need urgent guidance or when you can see that there appear to be several staff members present but still no response.
I have also become increasingly concerned about the lack of diversity and representation within the practice. It often feels like the staff team does not reflect or understand the diverse community they serve, which affects communication and trust. This is not about anyone’s background individually, but about the importance of having a staff team that is inclusive, varied, and able to connect with all patients.
Over the years, I have consistently experienced rude and dismissive behaviour from both reception staff and management, with very little empathy or willingness to help. This is not what patients should encounter when seeking medical support.

Overall, these repeated experiences have made accessing care far more stressful than it should be. I hope the practice seriously reviews its customer-service standards, appointment-management processes, and communication with patients, as these issues are preventing people from receiving the support they need.
The management team has also been disappointing, as their communication and attitude have felt similarly unprofessional. Rather than addressing concerns or offering solutions, interactions with management have often left me feeling unheard and disappointed.
I regret not taking actions in the past and taken my complaint further  maybe this service would be better now.

If anyone is unhappy like me about  the service at this GP surgery and would like a formal investigation to begin, you have the right to make an official complaint. You can send your concerns directly to the Practice Manager most problably is ignored or dismissed considering the unprofessional approach they have you can skip this and take it to those who would listen.
Take it higher for an independent review, you can complain to your local NHS Integrated Care Board (ICB).
